sections.headline: Your questions, answered.
sections.subheadline: Everything you need to know about insurance, memberships, and our care model.
sections.interactivity: FAQ accordion with smooth open/close transitions.

items.title: Do you accept insurance?
items.description: Yes, we accept most major PPO insurance plans for medical visits. Our membership fee covers the non-clinical amenities like 24/7 texting.

items.title: What is the membership fee?
items.description: Our membership is $40/month per child, which provides direct access to your doctor and our custom parent app.

items.title: Can I book a same-day appointment?
items.description: Absolutely. We reserve slots every day for urgent sick visits to ensure your child is seen when they need it most.

items.title: How does the 24/7 texting work?
items.description: Members can message our clinical team anytime through our secure app for medical advice, refills, or scheduling.

items.title: Where are you located?
items.description: Our flagship clinic is located in the South Lake Union neighborhood of Seattle, with easy parking for parents.
